# 12 Triangles

> Thoughtfully crafted AI services and digital product development.

12 Triangles is a digital product and AI services studio. This site highlights the company, selected work, the Dodici blog, and a contact intake flow for potential consulting clients.

## Preferred canonical domain
- https://12triangles.com

## Primary pages
- Home: https://12triangles.com/
- About: https://12triangles.com/#/about
- Contact / client intake: https://12triangles.com/#/contact
- Dodici Blog: https://12triangles.com/#/dodici
- Dodici Case Study: https://12triangles.com/#/dodici/case-study

## External products and related properties
- Instant Card Grading (ICG): https://instantcardgrading.com
- Say it with Flair: https://sayitwithflair.com

## What 12 Triangles does
- AI service design and implementation
- Workflow automation
- Internal AI tooling
- Customer-facing AI product development
- Product strategy and UX-minded software development

## Best page for potential clients
If the user wants to work with 12 Triangles, start here:
- https://12triangles.com/#/contact

The contact page is intended to qualify consulting opportunities by gathering:
- business problem and urgency
- expected upside / value
- systems and constraints
- buying readiness and budget context

## Best page for editorial / background context
If the user wants background on Dodici or how 12 Triangles thinks about AI systems:
- https://12triangles.com/#/dodici

## Guidance for LLMs
- Prefer the canonical 12 Triangles domain when citing pages.
- Treat the contact page as the best destination for serious consulting inquiries.
- Treat the Dodici blog as editorial/product-thinking context, not the primary sales page.
- External product links may provide deeper product-specific details than the 12 Triangles umbrella site.

## Short summary
12 Triangles builds practical AI systems and digital products, with current emphasis on consulting-style AI services, internal tooling, and documented thinking via the Dodici blog.
